articles.title: Prime Minister Carney to participate in peace negotiations for Ukraine in France
articles.mainIdea: Prime Minister Carney to participate in peace negotiations for Ukraine in France
articles.summary: CNW Group: Prime Minister Carney to participate in peace negotiations for Ukraine in France. Canada is working with international partners to secure a just and lasting peace for Ukraine. To that end, the Prime Minister, Mark Carney, today announced that he will travel to Paris, France, from January 5 to 6, 2026, to meet with fellow leaders of the Coalition of the Willing. Together, they will accelerate efforts toward a negotiated peace for Ukraine, supported by strong security guarantees.
